name: v1.0-11200
body:
WhoFavorites, lets you store and replay /who queries.
Wait 15-20seconds between requests, who is throttled.
/who accepts a few command-line switches
- x-y limits the level range (eg. 15-25)
- z-"zonename" limits results to the zone (eg. z-"Ironforge")
- n-"name" limits results to matches / partial matches of "name"
- c-"class" limits results to class (eg. c-"Warrior")
- g-"guildname" limits results to guild

You can mix and match different switches.
Example: /who c-"druid" z-"Ironforge" z-"Stormwind" 35-45
